interface.longDescription: "Convert user-provided conference paper PDFs into distilled writing exemplar cards for the ccf-paper-writer skill. Extracts full text, analyzes writing patterns by venue, and produces ready-to-use exemplar cards with story patterns, abstract/introduction/method/evidence moves, and citation-style analysis. Use when the user wants to add custom writing exemplars, convert favorite papers into reusable writing templates, or build a personal exemplar library for a target venue."
